newsitem.title: THAILAND: Unocal to invest $1.38 bln in Thai natgas.
newsitem.headline: Unocal to invest $1.38 bln in Thai natgas.

text.p: Unocal Thailand, a unit of Unocal Corp, will spend at least $1.38 billion on gas field development in Thailand between 1996-2000, a company official said on Monday.
"In the next five years we will spend at least $1.38 billion in natural gas development and the Pailin field in the Gulf of Thailand will be our biggest project," she told Reuters.
The company's biggest natural gas project in this country is the Pailin field in the Gulf of Thailand.
The project is expected to come onstream in 1999 with an initial flow of 165 million cubic feet per day to be increased to 330 mmcfd in 2001, the official said.

The company sees itself as Thailand's major natural gas producer through the next decade, although its market share might slip due to additional supplies that may be generated by other suppliers, the official said.
Unocal Thailand currently produces about 990 million cubic feet of natural gas per day, accounting for nearly 70 percent of natural gas production in the country.
It planned to start oil and gas exploration on two new concession blocks in the Andaman Sea off western Thailand in November, the official said.
